newsitem.title: UK: Kern River shares dull on AIM debut.
newsitem.headline: Kern River shares dull on AIM debut.

text.p: Shares in newly-formed Kern River Plc made a dull start on the London Stock Exchange's Alternative Investment Market (AIM) on their first day of trade on Friday.
By 1224 GMT the shares were quoted at 47-1/2p, below the 50p placing price, although no trade was registered in the stock.

Kern River is acquiring U.S.-based CSV Holdings Inc, which has majority interests in and manages two oil fields in the U.S., Nukern and Starks. Proceeds of the float will finance the development of the fields.
At the issue price the company had a market capitalisation of 4.5 million stg.
The float raised 1.0 million stg net and the broker to the float was Marshall Securities.
